context_files_read.purpose: Controlling repository safety and phase-loop contract.
key_findings: Machine-readable artifacts are the product; reports are only views.
Fake-only gates must not be presented as real Valkey evidence.
Missing metrics must be encoded as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is not automatic and must not be run without explicit opt-in.

context_files_read.purpose: Autonomous loop entrypoint and phase boundary constraints.
key_findings: Automatic work stops at P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100.
P14 requires VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN and is dry-run/resource/planner only.
Reports must read artifacts and must not become source of truth.
Repository is a Codex bootstrap for valkey-scale-lab.
The automatic loop stops after P13; P14 is not automatic.

context_files_read.purpose: Phase requirements, real evidence boundaries, required artifacts, and P14 optional dry-run definition.
key_findings: P03-P11 each require committed real Valkey evidence artifacts.
P12 requires 10 and 30 node real evidence; P13 requires 50 and 100 node real evidence.
P14 is automatic=false, real_valkey_required=false, and its gates are resource preflight plus planner dry-run with explicit opt-in.

context_files_read.purpose: Subagent output schema and role responsibilities.
key_findings: requirements_analyst must analyze requirements and gaps only, not write code.
The required output path is artifacts/loop_engineering/stages/<stage>/subagents/requirements_analyst.json.
The main loop requires an APPROVED requirements verdict before implementation can proceed.

context_files_read.purpose: Harness policy for artifact-first behavior and anti-regression rules.
key_findings: Analysis and reporting must read machine-readable artifacts, not Markdown reports.
Real Valkey evidence requires real_valkey=true, Valkey 9.1.x, observed node count, expected cluster state, data path proof, cleanup, and schema validation.
1000+ defaults are forbidden; 1000+ coverage is dry-run/resource/planner only unless separately authorized.
L03 must establish a unified metric catalog and coverage matrix.
Coverage must span cluster build, management, workload, observability, fault, failover, stability, cleanup, scale, report, and visualization.

Required harness includes metric_catalog and coverage_matrix schemas, scripts/build_metric_coverage_matrix.py, tests for fake plus real artifact coverage, and generated metric_catalog.json and coverage_matrix.json.
L03 validation must run python3 scripts/build_metric_coverage_matrix.py --out-dir artifacts/loop_engineering/reports.
L03 validation must run python3 -m pytest -q tests/metrics tests/coverage.
Stage artifacts live under artifacts/loop_engineering/stages/<STAGE_ID>/.
stage_result.json must record metrics_added, visualizations_added, real_valkey_gates, fake_gates, and known_missing_metrics.
Known missing metrics require status and reason.
agent_role must be requirements_analyst.
verdict must be APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, or BLOCKED.
additionalProperties is false, so the response must use only the declared top-level fields.

context_files_read.purpose: Stage read-context summary from the main loop.
key_findings: L03 must add schemas, builder script, tests, and generated report artifacts.
Coverage layers must include fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run.
Historical phase and gate artifacts must not be mutated to improve apparent coverage.
Audit status is PASS with zero blocking findings.
Automatic phase real_evidence_count is 13.
Historical manifest hash mismatches are allowlisted; P13 also has a non-blocking historical gate command mismatch.
P06 metric_sample and event JSONL artifacts lack optional producer/status metadata, which should be normalized by the catalog rather than hidden.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing provenance DAG and source-of-truth classification.
key_findings: Provenance graph status is PASS with 95 nodes and 70 edges.
There are 89 source-of-truth nodes and 6 report view nodes.
P09 report views trace back to source artifacts, but report/CSV/HTML outputs must remain views rather than metric sources.
P03-P11 evidence files show real_valkey=true, status PASS, Valkey 9.1.0 probes, and six-node small-real coverage.
These files provide real coverage proof but not a unified metric catalog.
Operations include duration_seconds and PASS/SKIPPED_WITH_REASON status.
Deferred destructive operations are explicitly SKIPPED_WITH_REASON and must not be treated as measured success.
Workload metrics include requested_qps, achieved_qps, latency percentiles, operation counts, timing windows, and errors.
These fields are not currently represented in a catalog.
Metric samples include cluster, docker, logs, and valkey sections per node.
Sample metrics include cluster_known_nodes, cluster_slots_assigned, connected_clients, total_commands_processed, uptime_in_seconds, used_memory, docker cpu/memory/net/block/pids, and log status.
JSONL samples are source artifacts and need schema-backed extraction into catalog entries.
Fault artifacts capture sandbox scope and safety checks.
Failover artifacts capture promotion and failover latency.
split_brain_duration_ms is explicitly MISSING with reason not_measured_by_primary_stop_gate.
analysis_summary contains normalized metrics and missing_metrics sourced from P08 artifacts.
report_index links generated CSV, SVG, HTML, and Markdown views to analysis_summary.
Coverage must mark report/visualization as views over artifacts, not independent metric evidence.
Orchestration operations include prepare/start/collect/stop durations and host placement details.
phase_summary marks remote_ssh_latency_ms as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON until explicit multi-host inventory exists.
Stability report includes bounded soak duration, memory growth, restarts, workload latency/error counts, and baseline status.
The first baseline is NO_BASELINE_YET with baseline_source SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
Per-node memory growth may be MISSING when too few samples exist.

context_files_read.path: artifacts/phases/P12_SCALE_LADDER_10_30 and artifacts/phases/P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100 representative scale artifacts
context_files_read.purpose: Scale-layer metric sources for 30, 50, and 100 node coverage.
key_findings: P12 has real 10 and 30 node evidence; P13 has real 50 and 100 node evidence.

scale_rung artifacts expose node_count, role counts, cluster_known_nodes_observed, az/host distribution, management status, valkey_versions, total_used_memory, avg_used_memory, and total_commands_processed.
P13 timing breakdown artifacts add setup/runtime timing surfaces that should be cataloged if included in report/scale coverage.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing tests around analysis, report, scale, and stability.
key_findings: Existing tests verify specific missing metric preservation, report rendering, scale rung summaries, and stability soak summaries.
No existing tests create a unified metric catalog or coverage matrix.
The new L03 tests must preserve existing expectations while adding catalog and layer assertions.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing producers and consumers of metric-like fields.
key_findings: Metric-like data is emitted from analysis, report rendering, runtime observability, stability, workload, management, and scale helper functions.
Current producers are deterministic enough for tests but use different field shapes.
L03 should normalize from artifacts without forcing historical artifact rewrites.

findings.description: The required L03 implementation artifacts are currently absent, so there is no schema-backed metric catalog, coverage matrix, builder, or dedicated metric/coverage test suite.
evidence: schemas/artifact/metric_catalog.schema.json does not exist.
schemas/artifact/coverage_matrix.schema.json does not exist.
scripts/build_metric_coverage_matrix.py does not exist.
artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/metric_catalog.json and coverage_matrix.json do not exist.
tests/metrics and tests/coverage directories do not exist.

findings.description: Metric sources are fragmented across heterogeneous artifacts and must be normalized from machine-readable source artifacts instead of report views.
evidence: P04 management_ops_report.json stores operations[].duration_seconds and skipped operation reasons.
P05 workload_report.json stores requested_qps, achieved_qps, latency, operation_counts, timing_windows, and errors.
P06 metrics_timeseries.jsonl stores nested cluster/docker/logs/valkey metrics.
P08 failover_report.json stores failover latency and a MISSING split_brain_duration_ms.
P11 stability_report.json and stability_metrics.jsonl store soak, memory growth, restart, workload, and baseline metrics.
P12/P13 scale_rung artifacts store node_count, memory, command, cluster membership, and placement metrics.

findings.description: Coverage layers must distinguish fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run evidence; P14 dry-run must never be counted as real coverage.
evidence: P03-P11 committed evidence provides six-node small-real Valkey 9.1.0 coverage.
P12 committed evidence provides real 10 and 30 node coverage.
P13 committed evidence provides real 50 and 100 node coverage.
P14 is automatic=false and real_valkey_required=false in codex/phase_manifest.json.
artifacts/phases/P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is absent, so the 1000-dry-run layer is presently SKIPPED_WITH_REASON or MISSING, not real.

findings.description: Missing metric semantics exist in several places but are not cataloged uniformly, and schemas are permissive enough that L03 must add stricter catalog/matrix validation.
evidence: AGENTS.md requires MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON for missing metrics.
P08 and P09 encode split_brain_duration_ms as MISSING with reason.
P10 encodes remote_ssh_latency_ms as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
P11 baseline_source is SKIPPED_WITH_REASON and memory growth can be MISSING with too few samples.
Existing schemas generally allow additionalProperties and do not enforce a shared metric entry shape.

findings.description: Report and visualization coverage must be represented as derived views with provenance, not as independent source measurements.
evidence: P09 report_index.json renders metrics.csv, missing_metrics.csv, baseline_comparison.csv, metric_chart.svg, report.md, and index.html from analysis_summary.json.
provenance_graph.json classifies report outputs as view nodes and has zero missing_source_count.
Harness policy forbids deriving analysis from Markdown reports.

findings.description: The fake coverage layer needs an explicit definition because committed phase artifacts after P03 are real, while existing fake coverage lives mainly in deterministic unit tests and monkeypatched producer tests.
evidence: tests/analysis, tests/report, tests/scale, and tests/stability create temporary artifacts with fake or monkeypatched data.
P00-P02 are fake-only/bootstrap phases and do not provide real Valkey evidence.
L03 validation explicitly requires tests verifying fake plus real artifact coverage.

proposed_harness.name: metric_catalog_schema_validation
proposed_harness.acceptance: schemas/artifact/metric_catalog.schema.json validates artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/metric_catalog.json and rejects catalog entries missing name, unit, source_artifact, scenario, node_count_scope, layer, and missing_semantics.

proposed_harness.name: coverage_matrix_schema_validation
proposed_harness.acceptance: schemas/artifact/coverage_matrix.schema.json validates artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/coverage_matrix.json and requires exactly the fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run layers with explicit real_vs_dry_run classification.

proposed_harness.name: metric_coverage_builder_cli
proposed_harness.acceptance: python3 scripts/build_metric_coverage_matrix.py --out-dir artifacts/loop_engineering/reports reads committed machine-readable artifacts and writes deterministic metric_catalog.json and coverage_matrix.json without running real Valkey or P14 gates.

proposed_harness.name: fake_fixture_metric_coverage_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: tests/metrics verifies catalog extraction from small deterministic fake artifacts, including MISSING and SKIPPED_WITH_REASON values with reasons.

proposed_harness.name: committed_real_artifact_coverage_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: tests/coverage verifies P03-P13 committed artifacts populate small-real, 30, 50, and 100 layers from real_valkey evidence and scale artifacts, while P14 appears only as 1000-dry-run.

proposed_harness.name: dry_run_not_real_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: A coverage test fails if any metric or matrix cell for node_count_scope=1000 has evidence_type real, real_valkey=true, or contributes to real coverage totals.

proposed_harness.name: report_view_provenance_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: Coverage for report/visualization records the source analysis/report_index artifacts and does not use Markdown, HTML, SVG, or CSV rendered views as source measurements.

implementation_plan.step: Define strict schemas for metric_catalog and coverage_matrix.
implementation_plan.rationale: L03 acceptance requires schema-backed artifacts, and current source schemas do not provide a common metric contract.

implementation_plan.step: Implement a deterministic artifact scanner and normalizer.
implementation_plan.rationale: Metric extraction must come from committed machine-readable artifacts under artifacts/phases and loop-engineering reports, not from report views or live gates.

implementation_plan.step: Map source artifacts into coverage domains and layers.
implementation_plan.rationale: The builder must explicitly classify cluster_build, management, workload, observability, fault, failover, stability, cleanup, scale, report, and visualization coverage across fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run layers.

implementation_plan.step: Represent missing and skipped measurements explicitly.
implementation_plan.rationale: Absent P14 dry-run artifacts, deferred remote latency, first baselines, and unmeasured split-brain duration must be encoded as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with reason and impact.

implementation_plan.step: Add fake fixture tests for normalizer behavior.
implementation_plan.rationale: L03 requires fake coverage and negative tests without relying on live Valkey execution.

implementation_plan.step: Add committed artifact coverage tests and dry-run boundary tests.
implementation_plan.rationale: The coverage matrix must verify real evidence layers from committed P03-P13 artifacts while preventing P14 dry-run from being counted as real.

implementation_plan.step: Generate the L03 report artifacts from the builder.
implementation_plan.rationale: The stage product is the versioned machine-readable catalog and matrix; any later reports must read these artifacts.

acceptance_criteria: metric_catalog.json and coverage_matrix.json are generated under artifacts/loop_engineering/reports and validate against new schemas.
Every catalog metric includes name, unit, source_artifact, scenario, node_count_scope, coverage layer, source phase, source pointer or extraction path, and missing semantics.
The catalog covers cluster build, management, workload, observability, fault, failover, stability, cleanup, scale, report, and visualization surfaces.
The coverage matrix has explicit fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run layers.
small-real coverage is backed by committed P03-P11 real Valkey evidence with Valkey 9.1.x and six observed nodes.
30, 50, and 100 coverage is backed by committed P12/P13 real Valkey evidence and scale rung artifacts.
1000-dry-run coverage is marked dry-run/resource/planner only and contributes zero real coverage; when P14 artifacts are absent it is encoded as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON or MISSING with reason.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN, valkey_e2e_gate.py, fault_safety_gate.py, and fault_failover_gate.py are not run for L03 requirements or validation.
No historical phase artifacts, gate results, or lock/manifest controls are mutated to improve coverage appearance.
Missing values are never invented or coerced to numeric zero; missing or unavailable values use MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with reason and impact where applicable.
Report and visualization rows reference machine-readable source artifacts and provenance; rendered Markdown, HTML, SVG, and CSV files are treated as views.
tests/metrics and tests/coverage pass, and existing tests/analysis, tests/report, tests/stability, and tests/scale remain compatible.
risks: The builder may overfit current artifact file names and miss future metrics unless extraction rules are documented and schema-backed.
Loose historical schemas may permit malformed metric-like fields; the L03 catalog schema must be stricter than source schemas.
Counting P14 planner/resource evidence as real would materially misrepresent scale coverage.
Using report CSV or Markdown as metric sources would invert the artifact-first contract.
Treating absent P14 artifacts as failure instead of SKIPPED_WITH_REASON could incorrectly block automatic stages, while treating them as PASS would overstate coverage.
Fake fixture coverage can be useful for extraction behavior but must be clearly separated from real Valkey coverage.
Historical audit findings are non-blocking but should remain visible; L03 must not rewrite old gate results to remove them.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, or scripts/fault_failover_gate.py for this stage analysis.
Do not count P14, 1000-node planner output, or resource preflight as real Valkey coverage.
Do not default any execution path to 1000 Valkey nodes.
Do not mutate historical artifacts under artifacts/phases or artifacts/gates to make coverage look better.
Do not hand-write PASS into gate results or coverage cells.
Do not scrape Markdown, HTML, SVG, or CSV report views as source measurements.
Do not invent metric values, substitute zero for missing values, or omit missing reasons.
Do not weaken existing schemas, gate locks, phase manifests, CI gates, or safety rules.
Do not use host network, firewall, route, interface, sudo, or global OS modifications.
commands_to_run: python3 -m pytest -q tests/analysis tests/report tests/stability tests/scale
notes: Requirements are clear and implementation can proceed to harness design. Approval is for the requirements analysis only; the repository still lacks the L03 schemas, builder, tests, and generated catalog/matrix artifacts.
